examples.name: Basic click-to-edit text value
examples.description: value/onConfirm mirror TextField's own controlled value pattern - onConfirm fires only on commit, not per keystroke. An inline TextField (context='inline') is the recommended child for most cases.

examples.name: In a Field
examples.description: Field's label names the field and its message describes it, through Inline Edit, which passes Field's id and ARIA props on to its child. A rejected draft shows validate's message under the field, above Field's; the field reads both.

examples.name: Read-only display (before any interaction)
examples.description: Inline Edit always starts read-only - the confirm/cancel buttons only appear once the field is clicked or focused.

examples.name: No visible action buttons (Enter/Escape only, once editing)
examples.description: actionButtons={false} hides the icon buttons once editing starts; Enter still confirms and Escape still cancels.

examples.name: Custom accessible names for the action buttons
examples.jsx:
<InlineEdit value={value} confirmLabel="Save title" cancelLabel="Discard changes" onConfirm={setValue}>
  <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Title" />
</InlineEdit>

examples.name: Rejecting a draft with validate
examples.description: validate runs on every confirm. A returned message keeps the field editing, with the message under it and the field marked invalid; the message then follows the draft until it's fixed.
examples.jsx:
<InlineEdit value={docket} onConfirm={setDocket} validate={(value) => (/^[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]-\d{6}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? undefined : 'Enter it as it appears on the court notice, such as MER-L-001482-26.')}>
  <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Docket number" />
</InlineEdit>

antiExamples.name: Multiple fields in one Inline Edit
antiExamples.reason: Inline Edit clones exactly one child - use a real form for multiple related fields.

antiExamples.name: Expecting an isEditing prop to show the buttons upfront
antiExamples.reason: There is no isEditing prop - editing always starts on click/focus of the field itself, never before.

antiExamples.name: Expecting onConfirm to fire on every keystroke
antiExamples.jsx:
<InlineEdit value={value} onConfirm={(v) => console.log('typed', v)}>
  <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Title" />
</InlineEdit>
antiExamples.reason: onConfirm only fires when the user commits the edit (clicking confirm or pressing Enter), not per keystroke - the in-progress draft stays internal to Inline Edit.

antiExamples.name: Dropping a bad draft in onConfirm
antiExamples.jsx:
<InlineEdit value={docket} onConfirm={(value) => { if (DOCKET.test(value)) setDocket(value); }}>
  <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Docket number" />
</InlineEdit>
antiExamples.reason: Editing has already ended by the time onConfirm runs, so the draft is lost and nobody learns why. Reject it with validate instead.
